# driver/context_loader.py before any prompt is built.

# Rows under <target>/ are the SHA-pinned per-target trees added by the
# corrections pass (issues A3-A5). Every condition for a target loads its
# files from that target's tree only, at the revision named in
# targets/<target>/target.yaml. Rows below the LEGACY marker predate the
# corrections pass and are kept only so already-recorded runs still
# validate; no new run may use them.
